en.title: Keratocyst in the lower jaw: one real case

sentences.text: This model follows one real, published case.
A man aged 54 had a keratocyst at the root tips of two lower left teeth.
It is a sac in the jaw. It is not cancer, but it often comes back.
The surgeon lifted out the whole sac, shaved the bone wall and cut off the root tips.
A gel made from his own blood filled the space.
Three years later the bone had healed, and the cyst had not come back.
There are several ways to treat a keratocyst, and how often it comes back differs between them.
